limitations: An improving edit does not identify the original faulty operation.
One declared input and contract only; unmeasured behavior may change.
Simulated executions, i.i.d. stationary shots; no drift or systematic model-error protection.
Gate noise can mimic logical defects; readout control probes only zero-state readout.
Target fidelity interpretation assumes calibrated measurement channels; readout/basis noise can bias witnesses.
Runtime guard checked between bounded jobs; it cannot interrupt an already executing backend job.

localization.scope: Tested one-edit set only; untested candidates remain possible

selection.tie_rule: Fewest two-qubit gates, depth, gates, then structural ID. Operational choice, not evidential superiority.

statistical_design.comparison_budget: No repeated refinement; all comparison is from simultaneous single-look screening intervals
statistical_design.loss: max normalized claim discrepancy; target state uses infidelity / tolerance; <=1 satisfies contract
statistical_design.ranking: Interval dominance, display by upper loss; preserve overlaps. Confirm only fresh candidate upper loss <=1 AND fresh original lower > candidate upper.
statistical_design.rule: One prespecified look per group/subject; union bound over (C+3)*M+1 intervals. Fresh paired confirmation after frozen selection.

verification.assurance: Hash consistency only; a party replacing both data and manifest can rehash. No signature or external anchor.
